Campus life

Programs offered and eligibility criteria

01Bachelor'sDirect entry, March intake
Programs offered

Undergraduate School of International Studies

  • Artificial Intelligence (AI)
  • Hospitality and AI Innovation (HAI)
  • International Business Administration (IBA)
  • Korean Business – Artificial Intelligence (KB-AI)
  • Smart Computing (SC)
Eligibility criteria
  • High school completed
  • Gap of no more than 2 years since graduation
  • English: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 4.0 or New TEPS 327
  • Certificate and transcript attested (apostille or Korean Embassy)
  • Bank balance over USD 16,000 in your or your parent's name, plus a 6-month statement
  • TB test certificate, if you are from a high-risk country (from an Embassy-approved hospital)
  • Interviews with KUAC and KDU
02Master'sDirect entry, March intake
Programs offered

K-Global Graduate School of Business and Technology Convergence

  • Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (ME-AI & DS)
  • International Business Administration (MA-IBA)
  • International Hospitality and Tourism Management (MA-IHTM)
Eligibility criteria
  • Bachelor's degree completed
  • Gap of no more than 5 years, with a document explaining it
  • English: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 4.0 or New TEPS 327
  • Certificate and transcript attested (apostille or Korean Embassy)
  • Bank balance over USD 16,000 in your or your parent's name, plus a 6-month statement
  • TB test certificate, if you are from a high-risk country (from an Embassy-approved hospital)
  • Interviews with KUAC and KDU

Scholarships up to 100% of tuition, plus part-time job support. e-Visa process.

03PhD and Integrated Master's and PhD3 years
Programs offered

Integrated Master's and PhD: Master's and PhD in one program

  • Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
  • International Business Administration

PhD: 3 years

  • Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (PhD-AI & DS)
  • International Business Administration (PhD-IBA)
Eligibility criteria
  • English: IELTS 6.0 or above
  • CV
  • Two recommendation letters: one from your university, and one from your company if you work
  • Research proposal or statement

Selection includes a 1-hour group interview with KDU. e-Visa process.

04EAP (English pathway)Leads into a KDU Bachelor's
Programs offered

Language pathways: intakes in March, June, September and December

  • EAP: English Language for Academic Purposes, leading into a Bachelor's
Eligibility criteria
  • High school completed
  • English: IELTS 5.5
  • A gap of over 2 years must be shown with documents (study, work, IELTS etc.)
  • Bank balance over USD 10,000 in your or your parent's name, plus a 3-month statement
  • TB test certificate, if you are from a high-risk country (from an Embassy-approved hospital)
  • Interviews with KUAC and KDU

Top EAP students can get scholarships for their Bachelor's studies.

05KAP (Korean pathway)Korean language program
Programs offered

Language pathways: intakes in March, June, September and December

  • KAP: Korean Language for Academic Purposes
Eligibility criteria
  • High school completed
  • Certificate and transcript attested (apostille or Korean Embassy)
  • Bank balance over USD 10,000 in your or your parent's name, plus a 6-month statement
  • TB test certificate, if you are from a high-risk country (from an Embassy-approved hospital)
  • Interviews with KUAC and KDU
06TransferMove to KDU from your current university
Programs offered

For students already at a university

  • Transfer into a KDU Bachelor's or Master's
Eligibility criteria
  • Currently enrolled at a university, with an attested enrollment certificate and transcript
  • English: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 71 or TOEFL iBT (2026) 4.0
  • High school certificate and transcript, attested
  • Bank balance over USD 16,000 in your or your parent's name, plus a 6-month statement
  • TB test certificate, if you are from a high-risk country (from an Embassy-approved hospital)
  • Interview with KDU
07ExchangeUp to 2 semesters at KDU
Programs offered

For students already at a university

  • Exchange for up to 2 semesters
Eligibility criteria
  • CGPA 3.0 or higher at your home university
  • Completed at least your 1st semester (7th-semester students can't apply)
  • English: IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 59
  • Recommendation letter from your Rector, VC or Dean
  • Bank balance over USD 6,500 for one semester, in your or your parent's name
  • TB test certificate, if you are from a high-risk country (from an Embassy-approved hospital)

One more semester's visa extension is possible in Korea.

Programs offered and eligibility criteria

01Bachelor's (direct entry)March 2027 intake
Programs offered

Bachelor's, English track: direct entry, or EAP followed by a Bachelor's

  • Global Business
  • Global Tourism Management
  • Korean Language
  • AI & Digital

Intakes

  • Direct entry to Bachelor's: March 2027 intake
Eligibility criteria
  • High school completed (provisional certificates not accepted)
  • English: IELTS 6.0 or above (IELTS 5.5 for Nepal)
  • Certificate and transcript attested (apostille or Korean Embassy)
  • Bank balance over USD 16,000 in your or your parent's name, plus a 6-month statement
  • Parent's employment and income certificates
  • TB test certificate, if you are from a high-risk country (from an Embassy-approved hospital)
  • Interview with KUAC
02EAP + Bachelor'sEnglish pathway into a Bachelor's
Programs offered

Bachelor's, English track: direct entry, or EAP followed by a Bachelor's

  • Global Business
  • Global Tourism Management
  • Korean Language
  • AI & Digital

Intakes

  • EAP + Bachelor's: December 2026 intake
  • EAP + Bachelor's also open for March 2027
Eligibility criteria
  • IELTS 5.5–6.0 for 6 months of EAP
  • CEFR, EFSET or PTE at B2 level for 1 year of EAP
  • Gap of no more than 2 years since graduation
  • Final marks of around 70%
  • No visa rejection record in Korea
  • 6-month bank statement with transaction history, and USD 10,000 or more held for 3 months

Scholarships

Scholarships by university

Scholarships vary from university to university. Here is what each of our exclusive partners offers international students.

Up to 100%

Scholarships at admission

For international students admitted to KDU Global degree courses (Bachelor's and Master's). Applies to the first semester. You get Category I (your English score) by default; if your English requirement is waived, Category II (your grades) is used instead.

Category I: based on your English score, plus Category II: based on your grades

CEFR (Cambridge)B2 162–179C1 180–189C1 190–199C2 200 or higher

  • CEFR: only Cambridge English Exam certificates are accepted.

About KUAC

About KUAC

KUAC (Korean Universities Admission Center) is an internationalization consulting firm in Korea and the exclusive admission partner for KDU Global, CKU and KBU.

We recruit genuine, qualified students from many countries, guide them through admission, scholarships and visas, and support them from admission to graduation. Every semester, KUAC welcomes thousands of students to Korea.

Why KUAC
